provenance.construction: Authored from generic node types and a simple chain, not an original project readback
provenance.limitations: Tests graph structure and lineage only; does not reproduce historical media quality or original private project evidence.

derivation_rules.overbuild_2x: source nodes and edges duplicated twice with __xN id suffix
derivation_rules.underbuild_60pct: first 60% of source nodes plus edges induced on them
derivation_rules.mirror_plan_linked: source nodes carrying source_node_id = own id (1:1 lineage)
derivation_rules.mirror_plan_half_mapped: source nodes where only every 2nd node carries source_node_id
derivation_rules.synthetic_source: 24 generic nodes, 20 simple chain edges; explicitly synthetic

cases.name: synthetic_same_scale
cases.why: Independent synthetic source and mirror with matching node/edge/type counts

cases.name: overbuild_detected
cases.why: a 2x plan must not pass as a mirror

cases.name: underbuild_detected
cases.why: dropping 40% of the graph must still fail the lower bound

cases.name: schema_mismatch_is_not_a_failure
cases.why: type vs node_type naming must not fabricate a failure

cases.name: mirror_with_lineage_passes
cases.why: a 1:1 mirror plan with full source_node_id coverage

cases.name: mirror_without_lineage_fails
cases.why: same scale is not lineage; mirror must be traceable to source nodes

cases.name: half_mapped_lineage_fails
cases.why: partial mapping must be visible as coverage, not rounded up to pass
